question: Why is the cooked rice dish prepared in this specific manner for Gaṇeśa?
premises: The ingredients should be cooked into a rice dish.
This dish is greatly beloved of Gaṇeśa.
The preparation is intended for Gaṇeśa.
inference: One should cook this rice dish because it is greatly beloved of Gaṇeśa.
plain_english: One should cook it; this cooked rice dish is greatly beloved of Gaṇeśa.
